experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/procedural/star-surface.ts

Seeded equirect photosphere texture for luminous bodies —
Sourcesrc/experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/procedural/star-surface.ts
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

_GRANULE_COUNT

Photosphere granulation cell count and contrast — fine convection cells (the Sun's boiling surface at telescope zoom), not the broad continental mottling planets get.

_SPOT_MIN

Sunspot field — activity threshold to draw groups, base group count, active-latitude band (equirect v-fraction), umbra/penumbra radii and depths, and the facula bright-rim strength. Depths/alpha are chosen to stay under the fresnel limb so spots read as magnetism, not dirt.

starSurfaceFor

Generates a seeded equirect photosphere texture for a luminous body — hundreds of small offset granulation cells modulate the star's tint so the sphere reads as a boiling photosphere (convection granules) rather than a smooth egg; the fresnel material modulates this map into the limb tint at grazing angles, which stands in for limb darkening + refraction. Returns undefined without a 2d context.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Star def (color = photosphere tint, id = seed).
  • @returns A CanvasTexture for the glow-sphere's color modulate, or undefined.
